hub.sub: Families compare colleges for weeks before they enquire. We plan search, paid media and follow-up around the enquiry, the campus visit and the admission.

answer.label: In short
answer.lead: College admission marketing is the work of getting students and parents to find your courses, enquire, visit and enrol within the intake window. It combines course and city search, campaigns around exam and result dates, a website that answers fee and eligibility questions, and fast, tracked follow-up from enquiry to admission.
answer.hl: find your courses, enquire, visit and enrol
answer.who: Monday Marketing Company (MMC) markets colleges and universities in India, connecting ads and the website to a CRM so admissions teams can follow every enquiry.

paras: A student and parents compare courses, fees, placements and campus life across several colleges, often over weeks. They read reviews, ask friends and check the website before they enquire.
Intake windows, exam results and counselling dates shape when they search.
blocks.cap: Students and parents on a campus visit.

blocks.h: The problem that keeps coming back
paras: Many colleges generate enquiries but follow up slowly, rely on one season of heavy spend and cannot say which channel produced admissions.

The fix is to answer fee and eligibility questions on the site, follow up quickly, invite enquiries to a visit and track each step. See the education marketing overview and our admission marketing plan for colleges.

stages.breaks: Waiting for the prospectus to be found.
stages.why: Families search the course and city. If you are not there, they compare other colleges.
stages.does: We run course and city search and campaigns around intakes. See SEO and Google Ads.

stages.breaks: A site that hides fees and eligibility.
stages.why: Families leave when basics are unclear.
stages.does: We build course pages with eligibility, fees process, outcomes you can document and a clear next step. See website development.

stages.breaks: Long forms and unclear next steps.
stages.why: A student or parent enquires on a phone, often in a hurry.
stages.does: We build short enquiry forms and landing pages and send leads to your CRM. See lead generation.

stages.why: Speed and relevance decide who a family speaks to.
stages.does: We set routing, reply timing and nurture series by course.

stages.why: Families read reviews and ask other families.
stages.does: We manage profiles and reviews honestly. See reputation management.
